title: 🏭 Sioux Falls Manufacturing: Several Roles, Many $70K+ Options
text:
1 days ago Sioux Falls manufacturing is busy right now—lots of plants are hiring and adding new shifts. If you like hands-on work, steady hours, and room to grow, this week’s listings look strong.
Production Team Member Employer: Oldcastle Infrastructure
Location: Sioux Falls, SD
Type: Full-time (non-exempt)
Salary: Not listed
Entry-level friendly role in precast concrete. You’ll strip and clean forms, prep steel molds, do light carpentry, and help keep the plant tidy. Oldcastle offers competitive base pay, medical/dental, retirement plan, and growth opportunities within a large CRH family of companies.
Machine Operator (1st Shift) Employer: Graco
Location: Sioux Falls, SD
Type: Full-time
Hours: 7:00am – 3:00pm, Monday–Friday
Pay: $22.05 – $27.55/hour
Run simple machine tools (drill press, laser, etc.) to make parts used in everyday products, from cars to phones. Day shift, clean work, and strong benefits including medical, 401(k), stock purchase plan, and tuition reimbursement .
Quality Engineer – Day Shift Employer: CJ Schwan’s
Location: Sioux Falls, SD – brand-new 360,000 sq. ft. facility
Type: Full-time (Day Shift)
Salary: $68,000 – $113,000/year + ~10% bonus eligible
Help launch a new Asian-style food plant from the ground up. This role owns food safety, quality systems, data analysis, and continuous improvement , and works closely with production and engineering. Great fit if you have a related degree and 3+ years in quality/food manufacturing .
Sr. PSM Specialist – Day Shift Employer: CJ Schwan’s
Location: Sioux Falls, SD – new ~400,000 sq. ft. facility
Type: Full-time (Day Shift)
Salary: $75,000 – $125,000/year + ~10% bonus eligible
Lead Process Safety Management (PSM) and EPA Risk Management Plan programs, with a focus on ammonia refrigeration and plant safety. Ideal for someone with 5+ years PSM/EHS experience and deep OSHA/EPA knowledge who wants to help shape safety systems from day one.
Shift Lead Employer: Preform Solutions, Inc
Location: Sioux Falls, SD
Type: Full-time
Salary: Competitive pay (exact amount not listed)
Lead a team of material handlers and oversee blow and injection molding production. You’ll keep machines running smoothly and watch product quality. Comes with full benefits and leadership responsibility on the floor.
Governance Senior Engineering Specialist Employer: Smithfield Foods
Location: Sioux Falls, SD
Type: Full-time
Salary: $75,000 – $110,000/year
Travel: Up to 50%
High-impact role driving lean manufacturing and Manufacturing Intelligence (M-IQ) across multiple plants. You’ll build standards, lead trainings, run data-driven assessments, and support continuous improvement teams company-wide. Good fit if you have 5+ years experience and strong Excel/PowerPoint and CI skills .
